name: skillvault-authoring
title: SkillVault Authoring
description: Author and maintain skill bundles and catalog entries in the SkillVault repository, not application source or installed copies. Use /skillvault-authoring or /sv-authoring list, upsert, or remove; create/update are upsert aliases. Accepts legacy /skillvault-source, /sv-source, skillvault-upsert, skillvault-remove and their shortcuts. Can install afterward through skillvault-installation with separate target and approval.
author: wzlwit

inputs.name: action
inputs.description: Primary action; omitted means read-only list. Compatibility aliases remain in SKILL.md. Operation-specific approvals still apply.

inputs.name: nameOrUrl
inputs.description: Existing repository skill name to edit, new skill name to create from scratch, or source URL to derive a skill from. A name does not automatically import an installed copy. Required only for the selected operation, not status or help.

inputs.name: scope
inputs.description: Install scope after upsert. default means auto-guess from the created skill manifest. none means do not install.

inputs.name: repoPath
inputs.description: Explicit SkillVault checkout through --repo <path>. Relative to the working project; must pass Git-root and origin verification. Does not select the installation destination.
